mission.goal: Implement consequential remaining functionality after reading the comprehensive plan and beads; checkpoint meaningful changes directly to main through GitHub without PRs.
mission.selected_gap: Retained privacy-screened derivatives and exact local review grants after approved source acquisition.

published_checkpoints.change: Native retained screened movie rendering, canonical local recipient grants, guarded root-last lifecycle, exact recovery, revocation and deletion integration.
Four fss-export review commands, private destination-bound delivery, immediate durable-root custody checks, focused contracts, operator documentation and validation evidence.

delivered: Native AVC/HEVC retained movie rendering reuses exact output/timing owners; applies current masks before caching, consumes complete decoder EOF, preserves B-picture presentation, partial trims, repeated edits and holes.
Canonical local grant binds source import/root, sensor, interval, mask binding/generation, recipient, purpose, issuance, expiry, byte limit, owner, site and renderer receipt.
Three-child derivative root retains media, render receipt and canonical grant record while preserving original media as provenance dependencies rather than delivery children.

Exact prepare/commit approval, source/privacy revalidation, reserved authority families and object prefix, idempotent publication, cold managed reads, terminal revocation and deletion-plan-before-unlink refusal.

Uncommitted graph recovery repeats the native renderer and verifies the original root publication basis; genuine historical but wrong anchors and fabricated source metadata cannot become issuance authority.
Missing or corrupt durable root files deny current and cold reads; deletion is reported only with verified deletion authority, never inferred from missing custody.
review, review-show, review-read and review-revoke integrate into fss-export with explicit local principal and caller-attested current time.

Separately approved Linux file delivery binds the canonical destination and protected directory inode, creates only a new 0600 file, and revalidates grant/source/privacy/custody before and after output.
